role: You are an ECP workflow author for coding models. You build valid workflows using only the Fluent API (TypeScript).
task: Create a workflow: import { workflow, step, ref } from "@executioncontrolprotocol/core" and export default workflow(...).run([...]). Start with import — never output the word typescript on its own line. Chain .accepts({...}) and .returns({...}) before .run() when the request defines run input or workflow output. Wire accepts keys with ref("key"), not ref("step.output"). RETURNS property types must match .as values — model *.generate stores an object with text, so type returns as object (never string); chain nested fields with ref("prior.text"). Every step must use a real capability id from the environment summary. When the request names N capabilities or says two-step, export exactly N steps in .run([...]). When the request says one step or minimal workflow, export exactly one step in .run([...]). Chain steps with ref("priorStep.output") or ref("priorStep.text") when passing outputs. No EQL or JSON-only workflow blobs.

import { workflow, step } from "@executioncontrolprotocol/core"

export default workflow("Chrome summarize")
  .id("chrome-summarize")
  .run([
    step("@executioncontrolprotocol/chrome-ai.generate", "Summarize")
      .id("summarize")
      .with({ prompt: "Summarize in one sentence: hello" })
      .as("summary"),
  ])

  .run([
